tools.name: show_arcade
tools.description: Show the RIFFCADE: free open-source browser games that play well on a phone. Use when the user asks for RIFFCADE, the arcade, or a game to play or browse. Optional category filter (Puzzle, Arcade, Action, Racing, Strategy, Idle, Word & Math, 3D, Retro, 2-Player) or a search word.

tools.name: new_games
tools.description: Show the games added to the RIFFCADE most recently (new games arrive twice a day).

tools.name: play_game
tools.description: Open one RIFFCADE game ready to play, by its name or slug.

tools.name: rate_game
tools.description: Record the user's 1-5 star rating for an RIFFCADE game. Only call when the user gives a rating.
